description: Capability group: connector. Maps to command_scope::CommandScope::Agent (connectors/mcp live under Agent scope; see src-tauri/src/team_mcp.rs and connectors_catalog.rs). NOTE: Tauri 2 capability permissions system only covers built-in plugins (fs/dialog/shell/etc). For EchoAgent's custom commands, window-level scope enforcement lives in Rust via crate::command_scope::enforce(window.label(), command_name). This file documents the grouping and provides a forward-compatible scaffold for when command-level capability lands in Tauri (tracked as P0-3 follow-up).
